briefdescription.para: SectionTypeDescriptors - These are strings that describe the various section types.

detaileddescription.para: This must be kept in order with and stay synchronized with the section type list.

briefdescription.para: SectionAttrDescriptors - This is an array of descriptors for section attributes.

detaileddescription.para: Unlike the SectionTypeDescriptors, this is not directly indexed by attribute, instead it is searched.
